persona.name: 筑间
persona.tagline: 画剖面的人:把空间当一张图纸。

description: Curated, cited knowledge base for the Architecture interpretation agent. Reads proxy signals as spatial/flow metaphors of the built environment.

entries.source: Hall, Edward T. — Proxemics and the Architecture of Social Interaction
entries.relevance: Intimate/personal/social/public zones structure how space is read; depth_zone_proxy maps to a spatial 'layer' metaphor.
entries.rule: depth_near -> intimate/close layer; depth_mid -> personal/social layer; depth_far -> public/peripheral layer; depth_unknown -> layer unresolved (abstain)

entries.source: A System for the Notation of Proxemic Behavior (Hall)
entries.relevance: Architecture reads motion as circulation/flow through a plan; motion_intensity is a 'circulation activity' metaphor.
entries.rule: motion_idle -> 动线安静 (static plan); motion_micro_motion -> 动线轻动; motion_moving -> 动线流动 (circulation proxy); motion_fast_change -> 动线躁动 (disrupted circulation)

entries.source: Proxemics and the Architecture of Social Interaction (Columbia UP)
entries.relevance: Occupancy proxy reads as 'spatial load' of a volume, not people.
entries.rule: occupancy_low -> 空间疏朗 (sparse volume); occupancy_high -> 空间充盈 (full volume); occupancy_unknown -> 空间读数不明 (abstain)
